basic_details.scholarship_name: Johns Hopkins University (JHU) Computer Science PhD Fellowship & Assistantship
basic_details.offering_entity: Johns Hopkins University (Whiting School of Engineering - Department of Computer Science)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Johns Hopkins University Homewood Campus (Baltimore, Maryland, USA)
degree_levels: Doctor of Philosophy (PhD in Computer Science)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to doctoral candidates in Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision & Medical Imaging, Robotics, Computational Biology & Genomics, Cybersecurity & Systems, and Theory of Computation.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: 100% of admitted PhD students receive guaranteed full financial support (~50 to 65 doctoral students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; typically 2 to 5 high-achieving Pakistani scholars admitted annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Guaranteed 5-year full doctoral funding package (tuition waiver + 12-month living stipend + health benefits)

nationality_requirements: Open to international and domestic applicants holding a valid passport
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (BS) or Master's degree (MS) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or closely related STEM discipline from an HEC-recognized university with high academic distinction (minimum cumulative GPA of 3.60 / 4.00; competitive admits typically 3.85+ / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: JHU Whiting School evaluates international transcripts holistically; rigorous coursework in discrete mathematics, algorithms, and systems is paramount.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced coursework in algorithms, data structures, computer systems, linear algebra, calculus, and probability.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final year of BS or MS can apply; degree conferral required before August matriculation.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Demonstrated academic research capability through peer-reviewed publications (ACL, EMNLP, CVPR, NeurIPS, MICCAI) or substantial research software development is primary.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: TOEFL iBT min 100 (sub-scores 22+) or IELTS Academic min 7.0 (each section 6.5+). Duolingo and MOI certificates are not accepted.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: None; women in STEM initiatives actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Top applicants nominated for Whiting School Dean's Fellowships and Center for Language and Speech Processing (CLSP) Fellowships.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Recipients of external awards receive institutional stipend top-ups.

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition waiver covering 100% of Whiting School of Engineering graduate tuition (~USD 62,000 / year value).

admission_application_fee.details: Whiting School of Engineering graduate application fee of USD 75 paid online.

accommodation.details: Paid from guaranteed living stipend; off-campus apartments near Homewood campus (Charles Village, Roland Park, Hampden) average USD 750 to 1,100/month for shared housing.

monthly_stipend.details: Guaranteed 12-month annual living stipend of USD 42,000 to USD 46,000 / year (~USD 3,500 to 3,833 / month; ~PKR 980,000 to 1,073,000 / month) provided via Graduate Research Assistantships (GRA) or Teaching Assistantships (TA).

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Baltimore/Washington International Airport (BWI) / Washington Dulles (IAD) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 Visa fee (USD 185) and SEVIS I-901 fee (USD 350) paid to US government.

health_insurance.details: JHU Student Health Benefit Plan (SHBP) fully covered (~USD 4,200 / year value), including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

food_allowance.details: Food and living subsistence covered comfortably by the 12-month doctoral stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: High-end compute workstations, GPU clusters (MARCC / Rockfish supercomputer), and lab instrumentation provided by department.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental and advisor travel funds cover registration, airfare, and hotel costs (USD 1,500 to 3,000 per conference) for presenting accepted papers at leading conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Hopkins Shuttle system provides free unlimited transit connecting Homewood, Mount Vernon, and East Baltimore (JHMI) medical campus.

university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS or MS in CS/STEM with 3.6+ GPA, 3 letters of recommendation, statement of purpose, CV, and TOEFL 100+ or IELTS 7.0+. GRE is not required.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: CLSP (NLP/speech) and medical imaging/robotics are world-famous and attract extraordinary competition; systems, security, and theory offer slightly higher acceptance rates for highly qualified applicants.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Mention specific faculty members and research centers (e.g., CLSP, LCSR) in your statement of purpose, referencing their recent publications.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: JHU Whiting School Graduate Admissions Portal (Slate)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the JHU Slate graduate portal, select Computer Science (PhD), choose faculty research subfields, and upload required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (September - November): Research faculty laboratories at JHU CS, CLSP, and LCSR.
Step 2 (October - December): Create profile on the JHU Slate graduate admissions portal.
Step 3 (November - December): Upload statement of purpose, CV, transcripts, and register 3 academic references.
Step 4 (By 15 December): Submit application and pay USD 75 fee.
Step 5 (January - February): Faculty review applications and conduct technical video interviews.
Step 6 (February - March): Official PhD offer letters with 5-year guaranteed funding package released.
Step 7 (By 15 April): Confirm acceptance in the portal.
Step 8 (May - July): Receive Form I-20 and apply for US F-1 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic funding: 100% of admitted PhD students are awarded 5-year full funding packages without a separate scholarship application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three academic recommendation letters submitted online via the Slate referee portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose: 2-page essay discussing research experience, technical interests, faculty alignment, and doctoral goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated into statement of purpose; describe specific technical problems and methodologies of interest.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, research projects, technical skills, and GitHub repositories.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual technical interviews (30-45 minutes via Zoom) conducted by prospective faculty advisors evaluating research depth and technical problem solving.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: TOEFL iBT (100+) or IELTS Academic (7.0+). GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Unofficial scans uploaded for review; official transcripts required upon admission offer.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for non-English credentials.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via the JHU Slate application portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned electronic copies of official transcripts from all undergraduate and graduate institutions attended.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS transcripts with grading scale; official HEC attestation required only upon matriculation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 2-page statement of purpose articulating research questions, past projects, technical methodology, and why JHU faculty are an ideal fit.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on research depth and technical contributions rather than generic personal background.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Three confidential recommendation letters from professors or research scientists familiar with your creative research capacity.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure professors submit from verified university domain email addresses (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Comprehensive CV detailing academic history, research projects, technical skills, publications, and GitHub links.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly differentiate peer-reviewed publications, preprints, and coursework projects.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official TOEFL iBT (code 5332) or IELTS Academic score report taken within past 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Aim for TOEFL 105+ or IELTS 7.5+ to satisfy all graduate requirements.

required_documents_checklist.specification: PDF copies of published papers or arXiv preprints demonstrating research depth.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Submitting first-author papers at top conferences significantly boosts admission probability.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Admissions offered for Fall semester only. Hard deadline is December 15.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 25% (GPA, mathematics rigor, difficulty of computer science coursework)
selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 5% (academic service, leadership, contributions to computing community)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 40% (published research, statement of purpose, technical sophistication, code samples)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (industry research experience or advanced engineering roles)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (clarity of research goals and alignment with faculty mentors)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (credibility of referees and their specific evaluations of research aptitude)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 5% (alignment with faculty grants and technical performance in video interview)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: JHU CS Doctoral Admissions Committee and faculty lab PIs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty-driven holistic review: Area committees evaluate dossiers, match candidates to funded faculty labs, and conduct interviews before issuing full funding offers.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 3,000+ applicants for JHU CS PhD program
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~50 to 65 funded PhD offers accepted annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~4% to 5% admit rate for PhD in Computer Science
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3% to 4% among applicants from premier Pakistani universities
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/SE with top standing, 1-2 research papers at tier-1 international conferences (ACL, CVPR, NeurIPS, MICCAI), outstanding faculty recommendation letters.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of LUMS, NUST, FAST-NUCES, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: United States, China, India, South Korea, Canada, Pakistan, Iran

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging large sums claiming guaranteed admission or funding at JHU. Admissions decisions are made exclusively by JHU faculty.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Pay the USD 75 application fee only through the official JHU Slate portal. Never wire money to intermediaries.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: JHU strictly forbids the use of admissions agents. Plagiarized statements of purpose result in immediate disqualification.
hidden_costs_breakdown: US F-1 Visa and SEVIS I-901 fees: USD 535 (~PKR 150,000).
Flight ticket from Pakistan to Baltimore/Washington: ~PKR 350,000 to 500,000.
Initial apartment security deposit and living costs: ~USD 1,500 (~PKR 420,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: GRE is mandatory for JHU CS PhD. (FACT: The GRE is NOT required for Computer Science PhD applicants).
CLAIM: Only medical students receive funding at JHU. (FACT: 100% of admitted Computer Science PhD students receive full 5-year funding packages).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites claim living costs in Baltimore are unaffordable on a student stipend. In reality, Baltimore offers significantly lower housing costs than New York or Boston, making the USD 42,000+ stipend very generous.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 or higher in all graduate coursework with satisfactory research progress.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research and academic residency on the Homewood campus in Baltimore.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews conducted by the doctoral program committee and faculty advisor.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Graduate research and teaching assistantships are capped at 20 hours per week during academic terms.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for US F-1 OPT with 3-year STEM extension and employer-sponsored permanent residence pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminates upon withdrawal; past disbursements are not subject to clawback.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Fellowships cannot be transferred to other universities.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing research areas or advisors requires approval from the Department Chair and finding a faculty member with research funding.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for 5 years; extensions into Year 6 are supported via faculty advisor research grants.
